In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the customer value management model is an effective tool for determining the value of a company s customers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
customer profitability is the most important metric for measuring customer value, but it is not the only metric that should be used.
we have shown that the customer lifetime value (CLV) is a useful tool for the management of a firm's customer portfolio.
the customer value management (CVM) cycle is an effective tool for measuring the value of a customer and for developing strategies for improving that value.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the value of a customer to a firm is not simply a function of the revenue or gross profit the customer generates.
customer profitability is a key driver of firm performance.
customer segmentation should be based on behaviors that drive customer value, and that customer value should be measured at the segment level.
